_rule: Every entry names a wrong number that exists in a product today, the value that replaces it, the method, and the file that carries the wrong value. No product outside this label was modified; the one exception is the additive, non-destructive sidecar prep_beamidp/beamidp_table.CORRECTION.json (nothing overwritten).

corrections.what: flown minimum horizontal separation, EVERY value ever published by this project
corrections.wrong_value: HV4SITL15 104.2 m; HV4SITL16 101.0 m; HV4W00 102.2 m; HV4W05 100.8 m; HV4W55 103.8 m; BEAMIDP1 182.7 m
corrections.method: exact continuous-time minimum over both aircraft's native ~6 Hz dataflash POS samples, in the WGS84 ellipsoidal frame the planner itself uses; cross-checked by an independent Vincenty inverse at the closest-approach instant (agrees to 0.0000 m)
corrections.why_the_old_value_was_wrong: hv_sitl_report.py:129-133 and binsep.py use a flat 111132 m per degree of latitude while hv_dccpp/scenario.py:87-88 uses the exact WGS84 frame (110757.52 m/deg here, 0.338 % less), and the binding B2-B3 encounter is almost purely north-south; on top of that the reporter interpolates ~1 Hz telemetry onto a 2 s grid, which is an upper bound by its own docstring
carriers_of_the_wrong_value: runs/artifacts/PAPERPLAN1/c4_params/c4_evidence.json (101.0, HV4SITL16 re-run of the reporter algorithm)
corrections.note_on_prep_check: prep_check said the 101.0 for HV4SITL16 has no product and must be DELETED. It does have one (c4_params/c4_evidence.json, a re-run of the reporter's algorithm, which rounds to the flat-frame 101.026 m). The right action is to REPLACE it with 100.685 m, not to delete it.

corrections.what: KPI table caption, calibration of the energy estimator
corrections.wrong_value: 「量測工具已對 HARVEST 自己的 S1/n=4 計畫校準，相差 1.62 %」
corrections.right_value: estimator error band -6.86 % to +2.31 % (mean +1.00 %) over 3 cells and 12 aircraft; S1/n=4 alone is +1.30 % to +1.32 %
corrections.method: parsed every per-aircraft err% row out of prep_baseline_control/out/stepI_dplan_rule.log and took min/max/mean
corrections.why: the string 1.62 does not exist anywhere in prep_baseline_control/out/*; quoting it would advertise an error bar four times narrower than the measured one. The conclusion is unaffected: 112.5 % and 114.4 % are still outside the band.

corrections.what: KPI table, the other 10 benchmark cells' fraction of the allocator's energy budget
corrections.method: d_ceq / D_model with D_model = 97.726 km, over the 10 cells with r1_over == 0; min is S1/16 (22.630/97.726 = 23.16 %), max is S5/16 (67.120/97.726 = 68.68 %)

corrections.what: Beam-IDP sequential-order makespan extrapolation, two conflicting values
corrections.method_kept: per aircraft: its own planned landing time plus the sum over ITS OWN cells of (sequential - Beam-IDP) turn time, then the fleet MAXIMUM. A1 2436.12, B2 2532.58, B3 2170.82 -> 2532.58 s. makespan is a max by definition and here it is set by B2 alone.
corrections.method_rejected: planned makespan + fleet turn-time delta / n_uav = 2348.04 + 581.15/3 = 2541.76 s. This treats the saving as if it were shared by all three aircraft.
corrections.estimate_caveat: entry/RTB legs and 4-D deconfliction are not re-planned in either method; the paper should quote the directly computed turn-time saving (-34.25 %) and mark the makespan figure as an estimate, or drop it for space
corrections.action_taken: additive sidecar written at runs/artifacts/PAPERPLAN1/prep_beamidp/beamidp_table.CORRECTION.json; the original file was NOT modified (it is generated by beamidp_table.py, and editing another label's product by hand would desynchronise it from its generator and violates the 'evidence lives under its own label' rule)
corrections.remaining_action_for_the_user: either regenerate beamidp_table.json with the corrected recipe, or accept the sidecar

corrections.what: Table Y claim that all four strip orders are bit-identical in the paper scenario
corrections.wrong_value: 「四種條帶序逐位元相同」 / 「所飛之條帶序與順序來回掃描完全一致」
corrections.right_value: the COSTS are term-by-term equal (42.32 s / 757.4 m per HERO cell at the 120 m cap; 42.35 s / 758.0 m at 119.5 m); the ORDERS are not - Beam-IDP commits [1, 0] in Z2_1_B_k1 and Z4_1_B_k1, and Held-Karp commits [1, 0] in Z3_1_B_k1 and Z4_1_B_k1
corrections.method: read every order array out of beamidp_table.json for both paper-scenario entries and compared them per cell
corrections.right_phrasing: 本情境無可改變成本之排序自由度，四種序之成本逐項相同

corrections.what: benchmark CSV provenance claim in the KPI caption
corrections.right_value: that CSV is UNTRACKED (git status: ?? research/cpp_benchmark/results/project_rows_5e0295f5_dirty.csv; the version-controlled one is project_rows_c5653199_dirty.csv), and research/cpp_benchmark/bench.py - which computes max_km - is MODIFIED in the working tree (' M'), while the CSV's provenance block records only swarm_coordinator.py and dccpp_path_builder.py, not bench.py
corrections.method: git ls-files research/cpp_benchmark/results/ and git status --porcelain research/cpp_benchmark/, run in this session

corrections.what: the paper's existing flight evidence exceeded the 120 m ceiling
corrections.wrong_value: 「最高高度貼齊 120 m 上限（最大超出 0.16 m）」 reads as compliant
corrections.right_value: HV4SITL15 and HV4SITL16 each exported 88 navigation items above 120.000 m (38/13/37) and spent 325.79 s and 330.13 s of cumulative fleet time above 120.000 m; flown maxima 120.1522 m and 120.1619 m. At the 119.5 m ceiling all four new sorties have 0 items above 120 and 0.00 s above 120.000 m.
corrections.method: dataflash POS.RelHomeAlt (~6 Hz), time-above by linear interpolation of the level crossings; corroborates c1_altitude/binlog_alt.json (147.3/56.8/126.1 s) to 0.03 s with an independent implementation

corrections.wrong_value: the disarm rule, quoted as the primary definition
corrections.right_value: last downward crossing of RelHomeAlt = 2.0 m across the fleet, on each aircraft's own GPS time-of-week clock: HV4W55 1281.91 s, HV4W05 1234.78 s, HV4W00 1207.88 s, BEAMIDP1 2272.34 s
corrections.why: the runner's 'below 2 m and disarmed' touchdown lands on the FINAL flight.csv row for the last aircraft in all four sorties, because the monitor loop stops at that instant - so the disarm makespan is partly an artefact of when logging stopped; and the runner uses ONE median clock offset for three instances whose boot clocks differ by ~1 s

corrections.right_value: 1 243 447.7 m2 (1.2434 km2) on the WGS84 ellipsoid; the nominal 1560 x 800 m is 1559.6 x 797.3 m there
corrections.method: meridian and prime-vertical radii at lat 23.95 deg applied to the scenario polygon, recomputed in this label; matches analysis/out/verify.json V3 to 0.2 m2
corrections.why: the scenario polygon was authored with the flat 111132 m/deg; the planner reads it through the exact GeoFrame
corrections.effect_on_coverage_ratio: none to 1e-4; only the denominator changes

corrections.what: EKF wind magnitude reported by the sortie runner
corrections.right_value: EKF3 (XKF2) cruise-band medians 4.94 / 4.96 / 4.93 m/s against a commanded 5.00
corrections.why: binalt.py pools NKF2 (EKF2) with XKF2 (EKF3) into one list and includes ground, climb and descent samples where the wind state has not converged
corrections.note: the runner is right that this field supersedes the broken mean_from_dir_deg (an arithmetic mean of a wrapping angle); it is still biased low by 0.10-0.14 m/s

corrections.wrong_value: one 3000x3000 Pioneer n=6 -> makespan 3842.6 s, listed under 'all at 119.5 m'
corrections.right_value: 3842.61 s is the 120.0 m figure; the same geometry at 119.5 m is 3013.88 s
corrections.source: prep_runner beamidp_sortie_c120.json / _c1195.json (both carry the cap in their _note)
corrections.effect_on_the_paper: none - the 3000x3000 geometry was rejected. But 'lowering the ceiling is nearly free' is only true for the paper's cell: on that geometry 120.0 -> 119.5 moves makespan 3842.61 -> 3013.88 s (-21.6 %) and min separation 190.6 -> 136.5 m. Any sentence about the cost of 119.5 m must be scoped to the paper's cell.

corrections.what: k increase with wind, as worded in the draft C6 note
corrections.wrong_value: 「W = 6 m/s 時為 213 m／130 m，W = 8 m/s 時為 245 m／151 m，跳帶數 k 亦由 5／3 增為 6／4」 reads as if k rises at both
corrections.right_value: R_eff 212.68 / 129.85 m at W = 6 with k STILL 5 / 3; R_eff 244.74 / 151.45 m at W = 8, where k first becomes 6 / 4
corrections.method: called hv_dccpp.platform.r_eff and hv_dccpp.dubins.skip_k at s = 96.591 in this label

not_corrected_but_flagged.what: the PLANNED separation is also an upper bound, not a guarantee
not_corrected_but_flagged.detail: hv_dccpp/sim.py:1007-1034 min_separation() samples a grid of cfg.dt_4d_s = 2.0 s (mission.py:1092) and takes the value AT grid points. Measured on these very tracks a 2 s grid overstates the true minimum by +4.19 m (HV4W55), +0.01 m (HV4W05) and +0.09 m (HV4W00); the error is grid-PHASE dependent, not monotone in the step. So 'planned 105.70 m' does not imply 'flown >= 100 m'.

not_corrected_but_flagged.what: HERO's R_theo = 75 m and phi_max = 25 deg are mutually inconsistent
not_corrected_but_flagged.detail: geometric value V_a^2/(g tan phi) = 78.9 m (+5.2 %); flying a 120 m GROUND circle at the downwind phase in W = 5 needs 26.07 deg > 25 deg. Pioneer is fine (19.69 deg <= 20 deg, geometric 129.5 m vs table 130 m, -0.4 %).
not_corrected_but_flagged.action: do NOT change platform.py's 75 before submission (it would desynchronise every existing product); add the Table 1 note instead, and never write 'R_eff guarantees the bank stays within phi_max'

not_corrected_but_flagged.what: coverage of the two wind sorties is not 100 %
not_corrected_but_flagged.detail: HV4W55 99.9666 % (415 m2 uncovered), HV4W05 99.9586 % (515 m2). HV4W00, HV4SITL15/16 and BEAMIDP1 are 100.0000 %. The planner-side fact 'uncovered subregions = 0' remains true for all of them (plan/mission_summary.json uncovered = []).

not_corrected_but_flagged.what: there is no WIND message in the dataflash
not_corrected_but_flagged.detail: 0 WIND records in all 18 .BIN logs. ArduPilot logs the wind estimate as the EKF state NKF2/XKF2 VWN,VWE; MAVLink WIND is telemetry-only and reaches flight.csv only because the patched runner mirrors it there. Any plan that says 'read the dataflash WIND message' is based on a false premise.
